notes: 6.3.2 From the above table it is apparent that the incidence of Child Rape increased in 1997 by 8.1 percent
over 1996 and by 30.0 per cent compared to 1993. The cases reported under Child Marriage Restraint Act
showed a decrease by 12.3 per cent in 1997 over the previous year. The incidence of Ahetment of
Suicide and Selling of Girls for Prostitution went up by 18.2 per cent and 50.0 per cent during the current
year. On the other hand, the incidence of Buying of Girls for Prostitution and Procuration of Minor Girls
declined by 40.9 per cent and 7.4 per cent respectively
